messages:
joanne: Heads up — ACME ticket #7279. They report a large jump in p99 on /v1/generate and intermittent 502s starting ~09:10 UTC. Customer impact: some requests time out after 10s. Escalating to oncall. @mike can you triage? :eyes:

mike: grabbing traces, running top of query across regions. quick check: p50 ~300ms p95 ~1.1s p99 ~3.9s for redwood-large on eu-west-1. Baseline p99 historically ~600ms. No obvious elevation in errors yet, but spike in queue latency for node pool gp2.

tilly: any deploys in the past hour?

deploy-bot: deploy recorded: service=realtime model=redwood-large version=2024-11-12T08:55Z user=eng-runtime id=deploy-20241112-0855

mike: yep saw that deploy. correlation looks strong — p99 jump ~2m after rollout started. I'm rolling back canary to previous revision and throttling new traffic.

priya: customer also reported auth failures (401) on some requests — could be a side-effect of retries/timeout. grabbing logs.

mike: rollback command I ran: ```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/realtime --namespace=prod --to-revision=42
```
I'll also add a temporary rate-limit rule for the tenant: ```yaml
- match: tenant:acme
  rate_limit: 15rps
  burst: 30
```

joanne: good. pls also enable model fallback to redwood-medium for ACME until we stabilize. We should KCI (keep customer informed).

tilly: adding circuit-breaker at edge for 5xxs: if endpoint 5xx rate > 1% for 2m, short-circuit to 503 with explanatory body and queue for retry. This will prevent cascade.

support-bot: alert posted to customer status page: "We are investigating increased latency for text generation in eu-west-1. Temporary mitigations in place." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: metrics after rollback: p99 down to ~680ms in 4m. 502s mostly subsided. Keeping ACME rate-limited + fallback until midnight UTC.

priya: auth issue looks like a spike of malformed tokens with higher retry TTL from SDK v0.9.4. Reached out to SDK owner to push hotfix. In meantime we've blacklisted malformed token pattern in ingress to avoid expensive auth checks.

joanne: action items: 1) mike — monitor p99 and confirm stable for 30m, 2) tilly — formalize circuit-breaker rule into eng-oncall playbook (PR #987), 3) priya — coordinate SDK hotfix + customer advisory, 4) joanne — send customer update and close ticket once stable.

mike: will keep watch and post diagrams/traces in thread. :thumbsup:

tilly: small note for postmortem — add a gate to deploy pipeline to run light perf smoke for top-traffic models in target region (5 reqs/s for 2m). If fails, auto-rollback.

joanne: agreed. documenting now. Thanks all.
